newsitem.title: FRANCE: Algerian secular party shuns government conference.
newsitem.headline: Algerian secular party shuns government conference.

text.p: Algeria's secular Rally for Culture and Democracy (RCD) party said on Monday it would boycott a national conference on the strife-torn country's political future called by the military-backed government.
"The RCD will not take part in the National Understanding Conference", the party said in a statement.
The RCD said previous talks with President Liamine Zeroual evolved positively as the dialogue was then carried out in transparency and the discussions were determined by the "force of the argument".

The RCD said the authorities came under pressure from "shadowy groups" -- which it did not identify -- and backtracked on reform proposals like the recognition of Berber as an official language alongside Arabic.
Zeroual has invited more than 20 opposition parties to take part in the National Understanding Conference next weekend to adopt a blueprint underlining his drive to introduce democracy.
